The '''Intergalactic Law Agency''', abbreviated as '''ILA''', was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] formed during the last century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to provide a galactic wide policing. However the agency was disbanded in favor of the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]].<ref name="CSWE" />
